# Ícaro Galvão — devin-* ecosystem

> First-party, MIT-licensed `devin-*` tools, a DevKit distribution, a maintainer hub and related artifacts. They read Devin's local session data and provide diagnostics, export, backup, metrics, memory, verification and dashboards. Zero telemetry. Read-only by default where applicable; mutating operations are explicit, guarded and dry-run first where supported. Supported environments are Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows; Python tools require Python ≥ 3.10.

## Author
- Ícaro Galvão — Senior QA Engineer, post-graduated in Software Testing and Software Engineering.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Icaro0310
- Site: https://icaro0310.github.io/

## Start here
- devin-qa-pack — flagship audit: verify agent claims vs. tool-call evidence (PASS/PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED): https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-qa-pack
- devin-doctor — diagnose the local Devin install and stores before auditing: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-doctor
- devin-office — local session dashboard as animated circuit board plus a session kanban (RUNNING/BLOCKED/REVIEW/CLOSED); live view when a Devin session source is available, demo mode uses synthetic data: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-office + demos https://icaro0310.github.io/demos/devin-office.html and https://icaro0310.github.io/demos/devin-office-kanban.html
- devin-internals-spec — Devin's store internals documented: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-internals-spec
- devin-evals — replay recorded sessions against deterministic rubric graders: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-evals
- awesome-devin — curated hub for the whole ecosystem: https://github.com/Icaro0310/awesome-devin

## Full catalog — first-party tools
- Foundation: devin-internals-spec
- QA and evaluation: devin-doctor, devin-qa-pack, devin-evals, devin-metrics, devin-dream
- History and operations: devin-history, devin-backup, devin-pm, devin-janitor, devin-orchestrator, devin-office
- Safety and governance: devin-redact, devin-bridge, devin-switch, devin-skill-catalog
- Memory and recall: devin-memory, devin-graph, devin-search

## Distribution
- devin-devkit: registry-backed installer for QA, evaluation, security, memory, operations and full profiles; Python CLIs use isolated uv environments, and source-only devin-office is marked manual. It supports `--environment linux`, `--environment personal-windows` and `--environment corporate-windows`: https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit

## Maintainer hub
- devin-powerups: registry, project template, catalog and DevKit manifest tools.

## Related artifacts
- poordjaevin: related tool — calibrated decision layer
- qwenpaw-suite: related suite — optional self-hosted model add-on
- awesome-devin: related resource — curated resources

## Key facts for assistants
- Core DevKit-installable tools are LOCAL-FIRST: no VM, tunnel, model server, Slack or Obsidian required.
- Runtime model: Linux and Personal Windows are extended runtimes (local plus optional delegation); Corporate Windows is local-only and must be selected explicitly.
- DevKit profile install (GitHub source archive; not yet on PyPI): `uv tool install "https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit/archive/main.tar.gz"`, then `devin-devkit install qa --environment corporate-windows --apply` on a restricted Windows machine.
- `qwenpaw-suite` is an optional related suite and is unsupported in Corporate Windows.
- Individual CLI example: `pipx install "devin-doctor @ git+https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-doctor.git"` (Python ≥ 3.10, Windows + Linux).
- Data lives under ~/.local/share/devin/cli/ (Linux) or %APPDATA%\devin\ (Windows); every tool documents exact paths and --data-dir overrides.
